name: Work orders
summary: Turns the production plan into parked work orders in the business's own system, checks component stock against minimums, and queues completion of finished work orders for a person to approve. Crons read and draft; a person approves every completion.

covered_by.prioritise: draft (one parked work order per product, sized from units per day over the plan horizon)
covered_by.plan-materials: read (component stock against minimum and maximum; shortfalls listed for the buyer)

crons.name: plan
crons.summary: Park one work order per planned product that has none open. 20:00 UTC is 6 or 7 am in eastern Australia.

crons.name: materials
crons.summary: Read component stock in the production warehouse and list anything below its minimum.

crons.name: complete
crons.summary: Queue completion of parked work orders whose due date has passed, for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a parked work order moves no stock and reads change nothing. Completing a work order moves stock, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

unleashed.covers: parked work orders (Assemblies), stock on hand by warehouse, completion queued for approval

gaps: MRPeasy: its pages describe manufacturing orders and shop-floor steps, but the kit has no MRPeasy platform, so nothing is mapped.
MEX Maintenance (mex-cmms): a maintenance CMMS rather than a production work-order tool; no kit platform and no mapped operations.
Odoo: the kit maps only one read (a version check); manufacturing order and job card operations are not mapped.
Unleashed: calls are signed by core (HMAC-SHA256 over the query string), but no call has run against a live account yet; the first live read and parked order are unverified.
Unleashed: a parked work order is created without lines; the bill of materials or the buyer must fill them. Confirm on a live account.
Unleashed: Complete is sent with no body; whether it needs quantities or lines is not confirmed against a live account.
Unleashed: list calls read the first page only (200 records); paging is not wired.
Labour time, downtime windows and quality release are not covered: the evidence does not describe them for this business and no mapped platform records them.
Supplier orders for shortfalls are not placed: the materials cron lists them for the buyer. Ordering from a supplier is a judgment step.
